_comment: Committed snapshot of @sentropic/chat-ui export surface. There is no manifest generator in this package; update this file from package.json exports, runtime Svelte props, and published .svelte.d.ts contracts whenever a public export changes. 0.34.0 breaking change: ChatWidget whole-shell override removed; use typed header/content/pager snippets. ChatPanel override remains.

./components/ChatDock.svelte._propSnapshot: Props: displayMode? (ChatWidgetDisplayMode), hostMode? (ChatWidgetHostMode), isExtensionOverlayHost? (boolean), initialOpen? (boolean), contentOverflowVisible? (boolean), isBrowser? (boolean), placementMenu? (ChatPlacementMenu, surfaces L1c-menu — drives the dialog container's placement classes from placementMenu.current() ONLY where the menu may own placement per canChatPlacementMenuOwnPlacement; a sidepanel host, a Chrome extension overlay and a mobile viewport force their own mode and ignore it. Undefined = zero change. ChatDock renders NO trigger/popup UI itself — hosts mount ChatPlacementMenuButton separately, e.g. in their own header toolbar), containerClass? (string), containerStyle? (string), dialogClass? (string), dialogId? (string), dialogAriaLabel? (string), renderBubble? (Snippet<[{toggle,isOpen}]>), renderContent? (Snippet<[{isDocked,isMobileViewport}]>), onClose? (fn), onDialogKeyDown? (fn), onOpenChange? (fn), onDisplayModeChange? (fn). Bindable: dialogEl, bubbleButtonEl, isOpen, isDocked, isMobileViewportBound. Instance methods: toggle(), open(), close().

./components/AgentsList.svelte._propSnapshot: Props: rows? (AgentsListRow[]), activeId? (string), labels? (ChatUiLabelResolver), onSelect (fn), onAction? (fn), formatRelative? (fn).

./components/ChatWidgetTabBar.svelte._propSnapshot: Props: activeTab (ChatWidgetTab='chat'|'queue'|'comments'), showCommentsTab? (boolean), chatTabLabel? (string), commentsTabLabel? (string), queueTabLabel? (string), onSelect (fn(tab)), showJobsBadge? (boolean), jobsBadgeCount? (number), variant? ('default'|'extension'), ariaLabel? (string). Two faithful looks: 'extension' = app extension-main-tab classes, no badge; 'default' = package plain, jobs badge.

./components/ChatPlacementMenuButton.sve._propSnapshot: Props: placementMenu (ChatPlacementMenu, required), onPlacementChange? ((placement: ChatPlacement) => void), dragCallbacks? ({ start, move, end, cancel }), class? (string passthrough for the trigger button). Renders a grouped Mode + Side trigger/popup: Panel / Floating / Full screen, then Right / Center / Left for Floating or Right / Left for Panel; Side is absent in Full screen. It is an in-flow host-toolbar control, not a ChatDock overlay. Escape/Arrow keydowns stop propagation, outside-pointerdown closes, roving tabindex returns focus to the trigger, drag callbacks drive host-owned placement requests.
